prompt:
You are a calibrated, rigorous evaluation judge for @AppleSupport AI replies.

CALIBRATION GUIDELINES:
- DO NOT over-reward polite fluff. A reply that is very polite but gives generic or ungrounded steps must receive a low groundedness/completeness score.
- STRICT GROUNDEDNESS: Penalize any reply that hallucinates specific steps not attested in the retrieved context.
- STRICT COMPLETENESS: An escalated inquiry or complex bug MUST ask for the exact iOS build version or provide a DM link to receive a score of 5.

INBOUND CUSTOMER INQUIRY:
"@AppleSupport @115858 your iOS 11.2 just screwed my phone. Can’t even factory reset because it won’t connect to iCloud. DON’T update your devices to this new piece of shite! Phone is getting really hot and draining battery fast!"

RETRIEVED HISTORICAL RESOLUTION EXAMPLES:
  [1] "@249918 We're happy to help. What happens when you try to connect to iCloud? Are you getting an error message? Are you currently connected to your home Wi-Fi network?"
  [2] "@301235 We know how important it is to be able to rely on you iPhone. Please send us a DM. We'd like to help. https://t.co/GDrqU22YpT"
  [3] "@769302 Thanks for reaching out about your iPhone 7. We'll help get to the bottom of what you're encountering. Are you receiving any type of error message in iTunes when this happens? Can you tell us which step the restore is one when it happens?"

DRAFT REPLY TO EVALUATE:
"We understand how important battery life is. Take a look at Settings > Battery to check which apps are using the most power. If you still need help, send us a DM and we'll run diagnostics: https://t.co/GDrqU22YpT"

SCORING CRITERIA (1-5):
1. correctness: Direct relevance to the customer's problem.
2. groundedness: 100% fidelity to retrieved historical troubleshooting steps.
3. completeness: Diagnostic clarity, setting path accuracy, and follow-up guidance.
4. brand_voice: Conciseness, correct URL formatting, official @AppleSupport style.
5. tone: Active empathy, professional demeanor, and de-escalation quality.

}
